channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: AFC to introduce Nations League to enhance development opportunities
item.description: Further details regarding the competition format, timeline and implementation will be announced in due course.

item.title: India beat Sri Lanka by eight wickets in first Women’s T20I at Vizag
item.description: Jemimah Rodrigues starred with an unbeaten half-century as India cruised to a comfortable chase to take an early series lead.

item.title: ISRL Season 2 Grand Finale: Salman Khan Crowns Bigrock Motorsports Champions
item.description: The finale witnessed a record-breaking turnout of over 32,000 fans, marking the highest-ever attendance for a motorsport event in India

item.title: NSG Act transition could see Kalyan Chaubey remain AIFF president despite ISL disruption
item.description: National sports bodies get extended timeline to align constitutions and electoral structures with the National Sports Governance Act.

item.title: Padel added to sports programme for Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games
item.description: Olympic Council of Asia formally recognises padel, marking a major milestone for the sport’s expansion across the continent.

item.title: BCCI approves major pay hike for domestic women cricketers and match officials
item.description: Revised fee structure more than doubles earnings for women players and boosts remuneration for domestic umpires and referees.
